item.title: More Than a Name: Stillwater Champion Grayson Eggum Embraces the Pressure of a Wrestling Pedigree
item.description: By Brian Jerzak It wasn’t Stillwater’s Grayson Eggum’s first time on the big stage. He placed at the Minnesota State Wrestling Tournament in 2024 and had won on the national stage. Eggum is used to the pressure of a big-time wrestling match. Even before he was winning on the national stage, people would congregate around his matches at youth tournaments.
